name: ConfigGraph Benchmark Dataset
description: This repository provides the artifacts required to reproduce the experimental results reported in the paper "ConfigGraph: A Three-Layer Runtime Configuration System with Inheritance Graph, Atomic Switching, and Safe Hot Reload" (submitted to IEEE Transactions on Software Engineering). It contains: (1) result.txt — all raw benchmark measurement outputs obtained on a Rockchip RK3588 platform (quad Cortex-A76 @ 1.7 GHz) using GCC 9.3.0, from which every latency and memory figure in the paper is derived; (2) the complete, sanitized input configuration set for an Autonomous Maritime Vessel (AMV) scenario — cold/hot YAML fixtures and a JSON fixture, including positive, loop, and error cases — used by the benchmark harness; (3) build.sh — the build script reproducing the exact compile environment; (4) README_AMV.md — describing the AMV configuration schema and how the fixtures map to the paper; and (5) MANIFEST.md — a file-by-file inventory. The ConfigGraph source code is withheld from this repository pending grant of related patent applications (filed, not yet granted), because public release before grant would compromise patent novelty under jurisdictions without a grace period (e.g., China). Reproducibility is nevertheless supported through the algorithm specifications provided at implementation level in the paper (§3–§5), the public dataset and configuration fixtures released here, and the documented build environment and benchmark methodology.
